detail.longDescription: ETHOS v3.1.84 Update 🛡️ We've updated ETHOS with key stability, privacy, and security fixes: 1. Patched a Vitest Path Traversal vulnerability (GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9). 2. Implemented ICE candidate throttling to eliminate Nostr relay rate-limiting. 3. Updated PWA meta tags for modern Chromium & Safari. Keep your client updated! # ETHOS # E2EE # CyberSecurity # Nostr # OpenSource
